title: Sort development releases after release candidates
body_md:
# Proposal: sort development releases after release candidates

Status: Draft (PROPOSAL, not accepted)
Proposes-To-Replace: PEP 440, section "Changing the version scheme" (suggestion only)

## Summary
Sort development releases such as 1.0.dev1 between the last release candidate and the final release, so that dev builds sort after rc builds.

## Conflicts found
- PEP 440 sorts `X.Y.devN` ahead of alpha releases and gives a rationale; this proposal must address it.

## Recorded contacts for PEP 440
- Alyssa Coghlan <ncoghlan@gmail.com>
- Donald Stufft <donald@stufft.io>
